question: Explain audit risk and its components.
sources: SA 200 Overall Objectives of the Independent Auditor and the Conduct of an Audit in Accordance with Standards on Auditing
SA 315 Identifying and Assessing the Risks of Material Misstatement

points.label: Meaning of audit risk
points.description: Audit risk is the risk that the auditor gives an inappropriate opinion when the financial statements are materially misstated. It depends on the risk of material misstatement and detection risk.

points.label: Risk of material misstatement
points.description: The risk that the financial statements are materially misstated before the audit; at assertion level it has two parts, inherent risk and control risk.
points.basis: SA 200, definition of risk of material misstatement

points.label: Inherent risk
points.description: The chance that an assertion is misstated, before considering any controls, for example complex estimates or cash that is easy to steal.

points.label: Control risk
points.description: The risk that a misstatement will not be prevented, or detected and corrected, in time by the entity's internal control.

points.label: Detection risk
points.description: The risk that the auditor's procedures do not detect a material misstatement; the auditor reduces it by changing the nature, timing and extent of procedures, and it moves inversely with the assessed risk of material misstatement.
points.basis: SA 200, definition of detection risk; SA 330 responses to assessed risks
